case.question: Compute Company A's Return on Equity (ROE) for fiscal year 2024 as a percentage, rounded to two decimal places. Use average equity.
case.context: Company A annual report. All financial amounts are in USD millions. Net Profit for fiscal year 2024: 500. Total Equity at the end of fiscal year 2024: 2500. Total Equity at the end of fiscal year 2023: 2200. No other values are reported.

response.notes: Return on Equity for fiscal year 2024 is not directly stated in the context; only Net Profit and Total Equity values are reported.

paths.formula: Rearrange [Annual Growth Rate of Common Dividends = Retention Ratio × Return on Equity] to solve for Return on Equity: parent_value/x0
Rearrange [Dividend Growth Rate = Retention Ratio × Return on Equity] to solve for Return on Equity: parent_value/x0

Rearrange [Dividend Perpetual Growth Rate = Return on Equity × (1 - Dividend Payout Ratio) ÷ [1 - Return on Equity × (1 - Dividend Payout Ratio)]] to solve for Return on Equity: -parent_value/(parent_value*x1 - parent_value + x1 - 1)
Rearrange [Equity Value Added = Beginning Shareholders' Equity × (Return on Equity - Cost of Equity Rate)] to solve for Return on Equity: parent_value/x0 + x2
Rearrange [Expected Dividend Growth Rate = Return on Equity × (1 - Dividend Payout Ratio)] to solve for Return on Equity: -parent_value/(x1 - 1)
Rearrange [Expected Dividend Growth Rate = Retention Ratio × Return on Equity] to solve for Return on Equity: parent_value/x0
Rearrange [Intrinsic Price-to-Book Ratio = (Dividend Payout Ratio × Return on Equity) ÷ (Cost of Equity - Growth Rate)] to solve for Return on Equity: parent_value*(x2 - x3)/x0
Rearrange [Per Share Value = Adjusted Average Price-to-Book Ratio × Return on Equity × 100 × Net Assets Per Share] to solve for Return on Equity: parent_value/(x0*x2*x3)
Rearrange [Price-to-Book Ratio = (Return on Equity × Dividend Payout Ratio × (1 + Growth Rate)) ÷ (Cost of Equity - Growth Rate)] to solve for Return on Equity: parent_value*(-x2 + x3)/(x1*(x2 + 1))
Rearrange [Shareholders' Equity Growth Rate = Return on Equity × Retention Ratio ÷ (1 - Return on Equity × Retention Ratio)] to solve for Return on Equity: parent_value/(x1*(parent_value + 1))
Rearrange [Stable Growth Rate = (Return on Equity × Retention Ratio) ÷ (1 - Return on Equity × Retention Ratio)] to solve for Return on Equity: parent_value/(x1*(parent_value + 1))
Rearrange [Sustainable Growth Rate = Retention Ratio × Return on Equity] to solve for Return on Equity: parent_value/x0
